+Secret: how a raw value is decoded according to ``--format`` and how a

+import os

+import select

+import stat

+import sys

+import time

+

+from . import messages as _messages

+from .logfile import NullLog

+

+_RESET = "\x1b[0m"

+_PREFIX_COLORS = {

+    "Error": "\x1b[1;31m",    # bold red

+    "Warning": "\x1b[1;33m",  # bold yellow

+    "Success": "\x1b[1;32m",  # bold green

+    "Debug": "\x1b[1;34m",    # bold blue

+}

+_BOX_COLOR = "\x1b[1;37;41m"  # bold white on red

+_STDIN_WAIT = 1.0

+_TRUE = {"true", "yes", "on", "1", "always", "force"}

+_FALSE = {"false", "no", "off", "0", "never", "none"}

+

+

+def _isatty(stream):

+    try:

+        return bool(stream.isatty())

+    except (AttributeError, ValueError, OSError):

+        return False

+

+

+def color_enabled(setting, stream, os_name=None):

+    """Decide whether to colorize: ``setting`` is True, False or ``"auto"``."""

+    if isinstance(setting, bool):

+        return setting

+    text = str(setting).strip().lower() if setting is not None else "auto"

+    if text in _TRUE:

+        return True

+    if text in _FALSE:

+        return False

+    return _isatty(stream) and (os_name or os.name) != "nt"

+

+

+def _pipe_has_data(stream):

+    """False when ``stream`` is a pipe/socket that stays silent for a while."""

+    try:

+        fd = stream.fileno()

+        mode = os.fstat(fd).st_mode

+    except (AttributeError, OSError, ValueError):

+        return True

+    if not (stat.S_ISFIFO(mode) or stat.S_ISSOCK(mode)):

+        return True

+    try:

+        ready, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], _STDIN_WAIT)

+    except (OSError, ValueError):

+        return True

+    return bool(ready)

+

+        except (AttributeError, OSError, ValueError):

+

+    def confirm(self, question, assume_yes=False):

+        if assume_yes:

+    def read_stdin(self):

+        if not self._stdin_read:

+            data = data.rstrip("\r\n") if data else ""

+            self._stdin_data = data or None

+

+

+class Tty(io.StringIO):

+    def isatty(self):

+        return True

+

+

+@pytest.fixture

+    return tmp_path / "root"

+

+

+def call(root, *argv, stdin="", stdout=None, tree=None):

+    out, err = stdout or io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()

+    code = run(list(argv), {"APPCTL_ROOT_DIR": str(root)}, out, err,

+               tree=tree, cwd=str(root.parent), stdin=io.StringIO(stdin))

+    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()

+

+

+def log_text(root):

+    return (root / "logs" / "appctl.log").read_text()

+

+

+

+def test_formats(root):

+    code, out, _ = call(root, "post", "list", "--format=json")

+    assert code == 0 and out.startswith("[\n    {\n        \"ID\": 1,")

+    assert list(json.loads(out)[0]) == ["ID", "post_title", "post_status", "post_type"]

+    assert call(root, "post", "list", "--format=count")[1] == "2\n"

+    assert call(root, "post", "list", "--format=ids")[1] == "1 2\n"

+    assert call(root, "post", "list", "--format=csv", "--fields=title,ID")[1] == (

+        "post_title,ID\nHello world!,1\nSample Page,2\n")

+    assert call(root, "post", "list", "--format=yaml")[1].startswith("---\n- ID: 1\n")

+

+

+def test_table_columns_follow_fields_and_align(root):

+    out = call(root, "post", "list", "--fields=post_type,ID")[1]

+    lines = out.splitlines()

+    assert lines[0].split() == ["post_type", "ID"]

+    assert {l.index(l.split()[1]) for l in lines} == {len("post_type") + 2}

+

+

+    out = call(root, "user", "get", "admin", "--fields=EMAIL,login")[1]

+                                "user_login  admin"]

+

+

--- appctl_core/logfile.py
+++ appctl_core/logfile.py
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+"""Invocation log file.

+

+Secret: where the log file lives, the timestamp format of each entry, the

+delimiter line written at the start of every invocation, and that write

+failures never interrupt the command.

+"""

+

+import os

+from datetime import datetime, timezone

+

+_RELATIVE_PATH = os.path.join("logs", "appctl.log")

+_TIMESTAMP = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"

+_DELIMITER = "========== appctl invocation (pid {pid}) =========="

+

+

+def log_path(root_dir):

+    return os.path.join(root_dir, _RELATIVE_PATH)

+

+

+def timestamp(now=None):

+    """UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 form, e.g. ``2026-01-02T03:04:05Z``."""

+    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)

+    return now.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime(_TIMESTAMP)

+

+

+class LogFile:

+    """Appends timestamped entries to the log file (or does nothing when

+    disabled)."""

+

+    def __init__(self, path, enabled=True):

+        self.path = path

+        self.enabled = bool(enabled and path)

+

+    def _append(self, lines):

+        if not self.enabled:

+            return

+        try:

+            directory = os.path.dirname(self.path)

+            if directory:

+                os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)

+            with open(self.path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:

+                handle.write("".join(line + "\n" for line in lines))

+        except OSError:

+            pass

+

+    def start_invocation(self):

+        self.write(_DELIMITER.format(pid=os.getpid()))

+

+    def write(self, text):

+        """Append ``text``; every line carries the same timestamp."""

+        stamp = timestamp()

+        self._append(f"[{stamp}] {line}" for line in str(text).split("\n"))

+

+

+class NullLog(LogFile):

+    def __init__(self):

+        super().__init__(None, enabled=False)
